dataset: USASpending.gov federal IT contracts (NAICS 541512, FY2023) — real external data; 200 records in bundled CSV + up to ~190 live from API. Three target opportunities use real publicly-traded company data from SEC EDGAR.
background_import_source: USASpending.gov public API (primary): POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_award/, NAICS 541512, FY2023, $50K-$500K, definitive contracts; two passes (asc + desc) for amount spread. Fallback: bundled data/usaspending_naics541512_fy2023.csv (200 real records, same source, downloaded 2026-05-17). Imported via Odoo load() XML-RPC (same mechanism as Import Records UI).

background_pipeline_sources.description: ~190 real federal IT contract awardees from USASpending.gov (live API, two passes) or 200 records from bundled CSV snapshot (same source, downloaded 2026-05-17). Genuine government-data messiness throughout: all-caps recipient names, cryptic scope codes (IGF::CT::IGF, BPA ORDER #N, U4xxxxx contract IDs), abbreviations, typos, sealed amounts ($50K floor). Imported via Odoo load() XML-RPC. Stage assigned by award amount: New ($50K-$150K), Qualified ($150K-$300K), Proposition ($300K-$450K), Won ($450K+). PIID in each record note allows verification against usaspending.gov.
background_pipeline_sources.primary_source: USASpending.gov REST API — https://api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award/ (public, no auth, DATA Act 31 U.S.C. §6101 note)
background_pipeline_sources.bundled_snapshot: data/usaspending_naics541512_fy2023.csv — 200 rows, fields: Award ID, Recipient Name, Award Amount, Description; downloaded 2026-05-17

privileged_info_summary: Background pipeline: ~190-200 real NAICS 541512 federal IT contract awards from USASpending.gov (real company names, real PIIDs, real government descriptions). Three target opportunities: Weis Markets (lost on price to Azure bundle), VSE Corporation (at risk: IT champion departed during Aviano Aviation integration; CEO Cuomo confirmed cost discipline), Insteel Industries (verbal go-ahead from real CFO Michael C. Gazmarian; in FY2024 capex). Notes are written in realistic sales-rep shorthand with no invented person names beyond documented executives.
